newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends with sizeable losses.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends with sizeable losses.

text.p: London white sugar futures fell sharply on Tuesday in reaction to lower values on the New York raw sugar market and knock-on white premium selling.
Trade and commission house sales kept nearby positions pinned down and the weaker New York opening encouraged trade selling of the March/March premium.
By 1730 GMT December was down $5.40 at $327.00 a tonne and March down $4.60 at $327.80.
Overall volume totalled 3,603 lots, dominated by the front two positions.
Despite another day in the minus column, technical analysts said the weak London market was due for an upside correction, given that values had moved into oversold territory.
Paris positions also lost ground. December was down $5.90 at $327.00 and March was down $5.90 at $327.50. Matif volume was 1,274 lots. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8057
